query:
SELECT l.id, l.title, l.status, l.quantity, l.remainingQuantity,
       COUNT(o.id) as pendingOrders
FROM marketplaceListings l
LEFT JOIN marketplaceOrders o ON o.listingId = l.id AND o.orderStatus = 'pending_payment'
WHERE l.status = 'reserved'
GROUP BY l.id
HAVING pendingOrders = 0
ORDER BY l.id DESC
LIMIT 20;
